_comment: airpit plan item 6 (docs/progress/airpit-release.md, 2026-10-11): optional sidecar read by tools/server/make_base_json.py next to tools/maps/airpit.json. OFFLINE DRAFT, not walked on the host yet: the first AirPit raid (plan item 12) must confirm every point with uibridge_teleport dryRun=true. Player spawns are the world positions (parent chain) of four of Arena's 20 original SPAWNS/ScavPMCspawn markers in Arena_Airpit_TeamFight_DesignStuff: markers 19 and 16 in the north pocket (z 75..80, yaw 180) and markers 4 and 13 in the south pocket (z -75..-72, yaw 0); the other 16 markers stay unused until ArenaMode team starts. The faction split (Usec north, Bear south, an All point at each end) copies Equator and is a guess. Bot spawns: markers 9 and 17 (north pocket) and 15 (south pocket) plus eleven of Arena's own AI core points (ids 6, 5, 17, 2, 1, 18, 15, 16, 3, 12, 13) read from Arena_Airpit_TeamFight_AI. All sit on the ground floor at y 0.1 (markers 0.08-0.14, Arena NavMesh surface 0.02-0.11). Core points 2 and 16 lie 0.30 m and 0.75 m from the border of Arena's own NavMesh, so east-north is moved 1.5 m east to (16.6, 26.8) and west-south 6.0 m east into open floor at (-40.1, -27.7); every point now keeps at least 1.38 m of border clearance in Arena's mesh (tools/validate/navmesh_oracle.py) and lies inside its single 8,168 m2 component. Two end points sit 4.4-4.6 m from a player marker, inherent to the small spawn pockets. The north-approach point (core 6) lay 1.5 m from the north exit centre until 2026-11-12 (the exit now stands in the north pocket, 16.6 m away); bots do not extract, and the 25 m radius makes the marker position irrelevant. Radii follow Equator (bots 25 m). waves and boss_waves are Equator's (bots-stage1/3), BotMax 8. Derived from Arena 0.6.0.47752 (the marker transforms read live from level28 equal the 0.5.4 package scene to 0.0001 m). No loot, no scav raids. 2026-10-12 (user decision, host raid 4): the passport-control doors stay closed and are the north limit, so SpawnPoint_Player_All (marker 19), SpawnPoint_Player_Usec (16), bot north-end-west (9) and north-end-east (17) moved from the north pocket (z 75..80) south of the door line onto open floor with >= 2 m Arena-mesh clearance (-21.5/61.5, -1.0/58.5, -23.5/62.0, 8.0/62.0). 2026-10-12 (host raid 8 dry runs on the U4 NavMesh, docs/progress/airpit-release.md 'Sealed-pocket anchors on U4'): three bot spawns stood inside shop fronts that the closed shutters and the authored outline walls seal off from the hall, so a bot spawned there would be stuck for the raid; each moved onto the main component of the U4 bake with >= 4.2 m of border clearance, >= 19 m from the nearest exit and >= 19 m from every other spawn: north-hall-west (-42.94, 33.84) to (-32.69, 30.15), 10.9 m, Arena's own patrol point hub2.7 (core point 17 sat in the DonB_Ramen_closed shop); west-south (-40.1, -27.7) to (-31.0, -25.5), 9.4 m (the TH_Roll_door shop in the south-west; core point 16, the origin of the earlier 6.0 m move, is the same island); east-south (19.59, -29.58) to (6.0, -40.5), 17.4 m (the DonB_Ramen_closed (1) shop in the south-east; its only mesh link leaves the outline across the east wall, so core point 18 stays an island too). Core points 16, 17 and 18 remain in airpit.ai.json as documented islands, like core point 7. 2026-10-12 evening (user report after walking the map, docs/progress/airpit-release.md 'User feedback: the north-east shop shell and the hall glass'): the north-east shop (Burger Spot, x 13.3..33, z 8..43) is an empty shell - shutters lowered, interior and inside doors removed, open to the north through Arena's own 4.6 m breach - so east-north (core point 2 + 1.5 m) moved west onto the hall floor: (16.6, 26.8) to (8.0, 26.5), 7.1 m from the core point, 4.4 m built-mesh clearance, 14.4 m from the nearest other spawn, about 40 m from the North Gate. Core points 2 and 4 stay inside the shell (documented, the room remains on the main component). 2026-10-13 (U6, the furnished hall from level38/37, docs/progress/airpit-release.md 'Phase 1b - package v8'): the four shops are walkable again and the six *_closed shells are opened_barriers, so the three sealed pockets and the empty north-east shell are gone; the four spawns went back to Arena's anchors: north-hall-west (-32.69, 30.15) -> core point 17 (-42.94, 33.84), west-south (-31.0, -25.5) -> (-40.1, -27.7) (6.05 m east of core point 16, which keeps only 0.75 m of border clearance), east-south (6.0, -40.5) -> core point 18 (19.59, -29.58), east-north (8.0, 26.5) -> (16.6, 26.8) (core point 2 + 1.5 m east). On the U6 bake (11332 vertices / 5212 triangles) all four lie on the main component with 1.50 / 2.18 / 1.89 / 1.80 m of border clearance; the shop back rooms that the furnished interiors leave closed are islands like in Arena's own mesh and no spawn stands in them. Host dry runs follow (uibridge_teleport dryRun). 2026-11-12 (user request after the ArenaMode session: more spawn points, docs/progress/spawn-rows-20261112.md): six Bot rows are APPENDED after the fourteen above (rule R1: the existing rows stay byte-identical, the new ones follow in this order; none starts with arena-<map>-tdm-v1-). Why: ArenaMode's burst selector uses only Bot rows at least 25 m (3D) from the player (rule R2: Tactical needs five such rows from wherever the leader stands, Deathmatch, Gun Game and Zombies one, pickups at least six usable rows). Sources: center-lane = Arena AICore ID 2 (LastHero_AI, CG 17) on its point (-6.63, 13.62); north-hall-centre = AICore 12 on its point (-22.88, 33.12); west-lane = AICore 3 on its point (-18.13, -10.38), the weakest pick (a narrow lane west of the fuselage, 15.0 m from the nearest row); west-hall = AICore 9 on its point (-29.88, 13.12); south-apron-west = Arena's LastHero marker 'Usec-Bear-Savage house (1)' moved 1.0 m to (-34.86, -50.82), 8.9 m inside the authored border; south-apron-east = Arena's AI born point p1 (22) moved 2.0 m to (16.5, -51.87), 7.5 m inside the border. All six sit on the main component of the built NavMesh at y 0.1 with 1.59 to 3.98 m of border clearance, none within 0.4 m of a solid, none inside a pocket, none within 21 m of a gate, each at least 14.8 m from every older row. Coverage (offline, tools/validate/spawn_coverage.py and an independent recompute): AirPit was already saturated for the 25 m rule (every cell of the walkable lattice keeps at least 10 distant rows before, minimum 15 after, median 12 -> 17); the gain is variety and less clustering: mean nearest-row distance 12.1 m -> 9.2 m and a Monte Carlo share of cases with fewer than two usable rows 3.2 % -> 1.0 % (eight other players). Two tier-2 platform rows (y 3.65, one level up) were rejected as optional. OFFLINE, host check pending: the host's 'spawn placement:' line and uibridge_teleport dryRun are the authority.
